info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the topaz/upscale/image/precision queue.

x-fal-metadata.about:
# Topaz Precision Image Upscale (Gigapixel)

Classic (non-generative) upscaling that stays faithful to the
source pixels.

## Models
- **Standard V2** — general-purpose, fits most photos.
- **High Fidelity V2** — preserves fine detail in professional
shots.
- **Low Resolution V2** — recovers compressed, low-quality sources.
- **CGI** — artwork and rendered graphics.
- **Text Refine** — keeps text and shapes crisp.
- **Faces** — Face Recovery 3, restores facial detail.

image_url.title: Image Url
image_url.description: Url of the image to be upscaled

sharpen.title: Sharpen
sharpen.description: Sharpening level (0.0-1.0). Default varies by model.

face_enhancement.description: Whether to apply face enhancement to the image.
face_enhancement.title: Face Enhancement

output_format.description: Output format of the upscaled image.
output_format.title: Output Format

model.description: Precision upscaling model. Standard V2 fits most photos; High Fidelity V3/V2 preserve detail in professional shots; Low Resolution V2 recovers compressed sources; CGI targets art and rendered graphics; Text Refine keeps text and shapes crisp; Faces restores facial detail with Face Recovery 3.
model.title: Model

upscale_factor.title: Upscale Factor
upscale_factor.description: Factor to upscale the image by (e.g. 2.0 doubles width and height)

subject_detection.description: Subject detection mode for the image enhancement.
subject_detection.title: Subject Detection

strength.title: Strength
strength.description: Enhancement strength (0.01-1.0). Applies to Text Refine model only.

fix_compression.title: Fix Compression
fix_compression.description: Compression artifact removal level (0.0-1.0). Not supported by the CGI model.

denoise.title: Denoise
denoise.description: Denoising level (0.0-1.0). Default varies by model.

enable_safety_checker.description: Authorized callers may set false to request relaxed screening.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

face_enhancement_strength.description: Strength of the face enhancement. 0.0 means no enhancement, 1.0 means maximum enhancement. Ignored if face enhancement is disabled.
face_enhancement_strength.title: Face Enhancement Strength

face_enhancement_creativity.description: Creativity level for face enhancement. 0.0 means no creativity, 1.0 means maximum creativity. Ignored if face enhancement is disabled.
face_enhancement_creativity.title: Face Enhancement Creativity

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The mime type of the file.

file_size.title: File Size
file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.

url.title: Url
url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
